repair_notes.mathematical_check: For an LO graph let N_s count ungauged two-derivative scalar vertices, I_b and I_f internal boson and fermion lines, and N_v total vertices. Its ultraviolet momentum degree is delta=4L-2I_b-I_f+2N_s+m+u. The identities L=I_b+I_f-N_v+1, I_f=nu+z-(F_L+F_R)/2 and N_v=N_s+nu+m+r+x+u+z+omega give delta=2L+2-(F_L+F_R)/2-nu-m-2r-2x-u-z-2omega. Removing one external momentum per external field-strength factor gives d_chi=delta-V, the displayed formula. Singlet decorations add no derivative excess. Four-derivative quartic-gauge insertions fail this LO derivative hypothesis and now cannot be assigned x.
